name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus with Musculoskeletal Manifestations
definition: Systemic autoimmune disease that can affect joints, skin, kidneys, nervous system, blood and other organs; musculoskeletal symptoms commonly include arthralgia and inflammatory arthritis.

typical: Photosensitive rash or oral ulcers may coexist

redFlags.item: Renal, neurological, hematologic or cardiopulmonary organ-threatening features

investigations.principle: Diagnosis integrates clinical features and immunologic testing; ANA alone is not diagnostic.
investigations.MRI: MRI is selected for organ-specific or musculoskeletal complications.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs are usually nonerosive in typical SLE arthritis.

amber: Immunosuppressive treatment depends on organ involvement and requires monitoring.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Autoimmune Shotha/Ama phenotype may be recorded only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Systemic autoimmune disease that can affect joints, skin, kidneys, nervous system, blood and other organs; musculoskeletal symptoms commonly include arthralgia and inflammatory arthritis.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
